_note: Public access areas that are not marine park zones. Garden Island (Meeandip) outline from OpenStreetMap (relation 21701685, © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), grown ~150 m so beach spots count as on the island. Access rules paraphrased from the Department of Defence (HMAS Stirling base induction page) and the Royal Australian Navy.

properties.name: Garden Island (HMAS Stirling, Defence land)
properties.note: Defence land. The public can visit the non-operational beaches and bays by private boat in daylight only, and must leave before dark. The causeway is for Defence pass holders only.
details: ✓ Line fishing from the open beaches and from a boat (normal rules)
✓ Spearfishing from a boat in daylight (normal rules)
✗ No access to the naval base and operational areas (signposted, mainly the south-east around Careening Bay)
✗ Not after dark — visitors must leave before nightfall
✗ No pets, other animals or plants brought onto the island
⚠ All native animals are protected (tammar wallabies, birds); tiger snakes are common — stay on the beaches
⚠ Moorings in Pig Trough and Herring Bays are private (GIFAA), not public
properties.source: Department of Defence — HMAS Stirling base induction; Royal Australian Navy

properties.name: Garden Island Causeway
properties.note: Closed to the public — only Defence pass holders and sponsored visitors may use it, so you can't fish from it.
details: ✗ No public access on foot or by car (Defence pass holders only)
✓ Fishing from a boat in the waters nearby is still allowed outside signposted restricted areas
properties.source: Department of Defence — HMAS Stirling base induction
